status: PROPOSAL (A-108a measurement) - thresholds are starting settings for a candidate scan, not tuned values; not used by the pipeline

header_band_frac.unit: fraction of page height; words fully inside the top band are running header text and ignored when asking whether text precedes a table
header_band_frac.status: setting (same 8% band as the running-line filter)

footer_band_frac.unit: fraction of page height; words fully inside the bottom band are running footer text and ignored when asking whether text follows a table

cell_pt.unit: pt; word start positions are rounded to this grid to find template text

min_pages_frac.unit: fraction of document pages on which a grid cell must hold a word to count as running template text (same 50% rule as the running-line filter, but position based)

top_zone_frac.unit: fraction of page height; running text is searched only in this top zone

bottom_zone_frac.unit: fraction of page height; running text is searched only in this bottom zone

cell_pt.unit: pt; word start positions are rounded to this grid to find template text

min_pages_frac.unit: fraction of document pages on which a grid cell must hold a word to count as running template text (position based, text ignored)

top_zone_frac.unit: fraction of page height; running text is searched only in this top zone

bottom_zone_frac.unit: fraction of page height; running text is searched only in this bottom zone

bottom_gap_max_frac.unit: fraction of page height; a table is 'ending the page body' only if nothing but running footer follows and the free space above the footer band is at most this

top_gap_max_frac.unit: fraction of page height; a table is 'starting the page body' only if nothing but running header precedes and the free space below the header band is at most this

word_slack_pt.unit: pt; vertical slack when deciding whether a word lies below / above a table box

x_tolerance_rel.unit: fraction of the wider table; left and right edges of the two tables may differ by at most this

column_edge_tolerance_rel.unit: fraction of the wider table; column start positions derived from the text layer may differ by at most this (informational evidence, not part of the score)

segment_gap_em.unit: em (word height); a horizontal gap wider than this starts a new cell segment inside a text line

column_start_min_support_frac.unit: fraction of the table text lines; a cell-start x position must occur on at least this share of lines (and on 2 lines) to count as a column start

numeric_cell_min_alnum.unit: characters; a cell with fewer alphanumeric characters is ignored when judging whether a first row looks like data

high_min.unit: score 0..1; candidates at or above are HIGH

medium_min.unit: score 0..1; candidates at or above are MEDIUM, below are LOW

score.note: a pair that meets the structural minimum but has a different column count or x extent is reported as LOOKALIKE (the 'looks consecutive but is not the same table' error class), not as a candidate

pymupdf_cross_check.unit: page tables detected by PyMuPDF find_tables, used only to count pairs with the same rules; not ground truth
